title: A Day in Congress (II): The Job

questions.prompt: He groups a congressman's job into how many main categories at the outset?
choices: A Three (vote; communicate; and related representation/work he unfolds).
questions.explain: He announces three categories for the job.

questions.prompt: Official constituent communication budget/tool he names is:
choices: B Only TikTok ads from PAC dark money.

questions.prompt: Expulsion from the House requires roughly:
choices: A Two-thirds of members (e.g., recent Santos case).
A Using best judgment entrusted by constituents on complex issues.

questions.prompt: A "delegate" model, by contrast, treats the member as:
choices: A Mainly a mouthpiece for constituents' wishes.
questions.explain: Delegate as mouthpiece of the people's wishes.
